# SOG v2 test fixtures

The fixtures in this directory are generated by `scripts/generate-fixtures.mjs`
and are released under CC0-1.0. They contain only synthetic pixels and metadata:

- `minimal-no-sh.sog`: four identical splats without higher-order SH.
- `minimal-sh1.sog`: the same data with a one-band synthetic SH palette.
- `expected.json`: expected metadata, decoded bounds, source RGBA texels, and
  the tolerance used for lossy WebP browser checks.

`generated/millipede.sog` is a direct, full-resolution conversion of the
116,374-Gaussian `millipede.splat` asset in the Three.js repository. It is
covered by a separate CC BY 4.0 attribution in `millipede.license.txt`; it is
not part of the CC0 synthetic fixture set.

`generated/lion.sog` is a direct, full-resolution conversion of the
195,099-Gaussian, two-band SH `lion.v3.spz` asset in the Three.js repository.
Its complete splat count and SH payload are preserved without decimation or
filtering. It is covered by the separate CC BY 4.0 attribution in
`lion.license.txt` and is not part of the CC0 synthetic fixture set.

`generated/tomatoes.sog` is a direct, full-resolution conversion of the
445,409-Gaussian, three-band SH `tomatoes.v4.spz` asset in the Three.js
WebGPU Gaussian Splatting example. Its complete splat count and SH payload are
preserved without decimation or filtering. It is covered by the separate CC BY
4.0 attribution in `tomatoes.license.txt` and is not part of the CC0 fixture
set.

`generated/moon.sog` is the original native SOG v2 payload for Nicolas
Diolez's Moon scene on SuperSplat, bundled into one ZIP without transcoding,
decimation, filtering, or SH reduction. It contains 4,929,011 unique Gaussians
and all three SH bands. It is covered by the separate CC BY 4.0 attribution in
`moon.license.txt` and is not part of the CC0 fixture set.

`generated/five-million.sog` is a reproducible CC0 stress fixture generated by
`npm run generate:5m`. It contains exactly 5,000,000 addressable no-SH
Gaussians arranged as a colored 171³ lattice (with the final 211 lattice
positions omitted) and is intended for high-memory WebGPU testing.

The WebP images are data images. They must be decoded without color conversion,
premultiplication, filtering, mipmaps, or vertical flipping.

## Integrity and on-demand Moon

Run `npm run fixtures:fetch` after cloning, then `npm run fixtures:verify`.
manifest.json pins the exact byte size and SHA-256 of all archives. Moon's
individual original files are also pinned. The downloader reconstructs a stored
ZIP using a fixed 2020-01-01 timestamp and verifies its final hash, without
transcoding pixels or retaining local user/OS metadata. moon.sog is ignored by
Git; all smaller archives remain tracked. If a local fixture has been modified,
verification fails instead of silently replacing it.
